headline: OpenAI proposes donating 5% of its equity to a US sovereign wealth fund, sparking discussions about AI regulation and public benefit
tldr: Today's AI news highlights significant developments in AI regulation, new custom chip discussions, and advancements in AI deployment. OpenAI's proposal to donate 5% of its equity to a US sovereign wealth fund has sparked discussions about letting the public share in the financial gains from the AI boom. Meanwhile, companies like Microsoft and Anthropic are making strides in AI deployment and custom chip development. Researchers are also exploring new applications of AI in industries like energy and healthcare.
